search_method: Broad Community product-area searches, category-page inspection, targeted feature searches, and date verification on article pages. conclusion: The Community sweep covered all twelve product areas. Recent matched scenario material was found for FortiGate and FortiSIEM; recent adjacent operational cases were found for FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiNAC, FortiNAC-F, FortiAuthenticator, FortiPAM and Secure SD-WAN.
